title: Make a list of three fruits
description: Create a list with at least three fruits, such as apple, mango, and banana. Print the list.
hints: Read the task once and identify the Python feature it asks you to practise.
Create and display a Python list.
Write your own code, press Run, and fix any syntax or runtime error shown.
explanation: A list stores several values inside square brackets. This example stores three fruit names.
commonMistakes: Use square brackets [ ] and separate each fruit with a comma.

title: Print the first item in a list
description: Create a list with a few items. Use [0] to get the first item and print it.
hints: Read the task once and identify the Python feature it asks you to practise.
Use square brackets with an index to access one list item.
Write your own code, press Run, and fix any syntax or runtime error shown.
explanation: List positions start at 0. That means colors[0] is the first item, red.
commonMistakes: Use index 0 for the first item. Index 1 is the second item.
